premise: When the rain comes Ladybug and Snail squeeze under Mushroom's cap, and then Frog — who loves the rain — squeezes in too, just to be with everyone; it's a squash, but Mushroom drinks up the rain and grows a little.
inspiration: The Mitten (Ukrainian folk), where more and more animals squeeze into one shelter; turned: the shelter grows instead of bursting.
lesson: There is always room for one more friend.
learning: Mushrooms pop up and grow fast after rain.

en-US.title: Mushroom Grows in the Rain
en-US.text: {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} [softly] Pitter-patter, pitter-patter. Rain was falling on the meadow. {ladybug:enter} Ladybug hurried to the red {mushroom:enter} mushroom {ladybug:go under mushroom} and tucked in under her cap. {mushroom:face happy} [warmly] "Come in!" said Mushroom. Slowly, slowly, {snail:enter} Snail came crawling. "Room for me?" {mushroom:live nod} "Of course!" {snail:go under mushroom} In he squeezed. Over in the pond, {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Frog was splashing. {frog:live jump} {sfx:splash} Splish, splash, splosh! [excited] "I LOVE the rain!" But under the cap, Ladybug and Snail were giggling together. {frog:face sad} Frog stopped. [sad] Splashing alone wasn't much fun. {frog:go under mushroom} So she squeezed in too. {ladybug:face surprised} Squish! {snail:live hide hold} Snail tucked into his shell to make room. "Too many!" said Ladybug. But Mushroom drank up the rain… {mushroom:glow} {mushroom:live grow} and grew, just a little. "Room for everyone!" said Mushroom. {frog:face happy} {ladybug:face happy} [laughs] So they giggled, all squashed together, until {canvas:rain stop} the rain stopped. {canvas:sunshine} Out came the sun. {snail:live hide resume} Out peeked Snail. {ladybug:go back} Out came Ladybug. {frog:go back} Out hopped Frog. [happily] And there stood Mushroom in the sunshine, just a little bit taller.

es-ES.title: Bajo el sombrero de Seta
es-ES.text: {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} [softly] Plic, ploc, plic, ploc. Llovía sobre el prado. {ladybug:enter} Mariquita corrió a la {mushroom:enter} seta roja {ladybug:go under mushroom} y se metió debajo de su sombrero. {mushroom:face happy} [warmly] —¡Pasa, pasa! —dijo Seta. Despacito, despacito, llegó {snail:enter} Caracol. —¿Hay sitio para mí? {mushroom:live nod} —¡Claro que sí! {snail:go under mushroom} Y se metió, apretadito. En la charca, {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana chapoteaba. {frog:live jump} {sfx:splash} ¡Chof, chof, chof! [excited] —¡Me ENCANTA la lluvia! Pero debajo del sombrero, Mariquita y Caracol se reían juntos. {frog:face sad} Rana se quedó quieta. [sad] Chapotear sola no tenía gracia. {frog:go under mushroom} Así que se metió también. {ladybug:face surprised} ¡Qué apretujón! {snail:live hide hold} Caracol se escondió en su concha para hacer sitio. —¡No cabemos! —dijo Mariquita. Pero Seta se bebió la lluvia… {mushroom:glow} {mushroom:live grow} y creció un poquito. —¡Ya cabemos todos! —dijo Seta. {frog:face happy} {ladybug:face happy} [laughs] Y allí se quedaron, riendo y apretujados, hasta que {canvas:rain stop} dejó de llover. {canvas:sunshine} Salió el sol. {snail:live hide resume} Caracol asomó la cabeza. {ladybug:go back} Salió Mariquita. {frog:go back} Salió Rana de un brinco. [happily] Y allí estaba Seta, al sol, un poquito más alta que antes.

ja-JP.title: キノコの あまやどり
ja-JP.text: {canvas:rain 0.7}{sfx:rain}[softly]ぽつぽつ、ぽつぽつ。のはらに雨がふってきました。{ladybug:enter}テントウムシさんは、いそいで赤い{mushroom:enter}キノコの{ladybug:go under mushroom}かさのしたへ。{mushroom:face happy}[warmly]「どうぞ、どうぞ！」 とキノコ。ゆっくり、ゆっくり、{snail:enter}カタツムリくんがきました。「ぼくも、いい？」 {mushroom:live nod}「もちろん！」 {snail:go under mushroom}ぎゅっ。池では、{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}カエルさんが、{frog:live jump}{sfx:splash}ぴっちぴっち、ちゃっぷちゃっぷ！[excited]「雨って、だーいすき！」 でも、かさのしたから、くすくすわらうこえ。{frog:face sad}カエルさんは、ぴたっ。[sad]ひとりじゃ、つまらない。{frog:go under mushroom}カエルさんも、ぎゅうっ。{ladybug:face surprised}むぎゅっ！{snail:live hide hold}カタツムリくんは、からにひっこんで、ばしょをあけました。「せまーい！」 とテントウムシさん。でもキノコは、雨をごくごくのんで…{mushroom:glow}{mushroom:live grow}ちょっぴりのびました。「ほら、みんなはいれる！」 {frog:face happy}{ladybug:face happy}[laughs]みんなでぎゅうぎゅう、くすくす。そのうちに、{canvas:rain stop}雨がやみました。{canvas:sunshine}お日さまが、にっこり。{snail:live hide resume}カタツムリくんが、ひょっこり。{ladybug:go back}テントウムシさんが、ちょこちょこ。{frog:go back}カエルさんが、ぴょーん。[happily]お日さまのなか、キノコはちょっぴり、せがのびていました。

de-DE.title: Der Pilz wächst im Regen
de-DE.text: {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} [softly] Tropf, tropf, tropf, tropf. Es regnete auf die Wiese. {ladybug:enter} Der Marienkäfer flitzte zum roten {mushroom:enter} Pilz {ladybug:go under mushroom} und krabbelte unter seinen Hut. {mushroom:face happy} [warmly] „Komm nur rein!“, sagte der Pilz. Langsam, ganz langsam kam {snail:enter} die Schnecke angekrochen. „Ist noch Platz für mich?“ {mushroom:live nod} „Aber sicher!“ {snail:go under mushroom} Hinein quetschte sie sich. Drüben im Teich planschte {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} der Frosch. {frog:live jump} {sfx:splash} Plitsch, platsch, platsch! [excited] „Ich LIEBE Regen!“ Aber unter dem Hut kicherten der Marienkäfer und die Schnecke zusammen. {frog:face sad} Der Frosch hielt inne. [sad] Allein planschen machte gar keinen Spaß. {frog:go under mushroom} Also quetschte er sich mit darunter. {ladybug:face surprised} Huch, war das eng! {snail:live hide hold} Die Schnecke zog sich in ihr Haus zurück, um Platz zu machen. „Wir sind zu viele!“, rief der Marienkäfer. Aber der Pilz trank den Regen… {mushroom:glow} {mushroom:live grow} und wuchs, nur ein kleines bisschen. „Jetzt passen alle drunter!“, sagte der Pilz. {frog:face happy} {ladybug:face happy} [laughs] Und so kicherten sie, eng aneinandergequetscht, bis {canvas:rain stop} der Regen aufhörte. {canvas:sunshine} Da kam die Sonne heraus. {snail:live hide resume} Da lugte die Schnecke heraus. {ladybug:go back} Da krabbelte der Marienkäfer heraus. {frog:go back} Und da hüpfte der Frosch heraus. [happily] Der Pilz aber stand im Sonnenschein, ein kleines bisschen größer als vorher.

fr-FR.title: Champignon pousse sous la pluie
fr-FR.text: {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} [softly] Plic, ploc, plic, ploc. La pluie tombait sur le pré. {ladybug:enter} Coccinelle a couru jusqu’au {mushroom:enter} champignon rouge {ladybug:go under mushroom} et s’est glissée sous son chapeau. {mushroom:face happy} [warmly] « Entre ! » a dit Champignon. Tout doucement, {snail:enter} Escargot est arrivé. « Une petite place pour moi ? » {mushroom:live nod} « Bien sûr ! » {snail:go under mushroom} Et il s’est faufilé dessous. Là-bas, dans la mare, {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Grenouille barbotait. {frog:live jump} {sfx:splash} Flic, flac, PLOUF ! [excited] « J’ADORE la pluie ! » Mais sous le chapeau, Coccinelle et Escargot riaient ensemble. {frog:face sad} Grenouille s’est arrêtée. [sad] Barboter toute seule, ce n’était pas drôle. {frog:go under mushroom} Alors elle s’est glissée dessous aussi. {ladybug:face surprised} Serrés comme des sardines ! {snail:live hide hold} Escargot est rentré dans sa coquille pour faire de la place. « On est trop nombreux ! » a dit Coccinelle. Mais Champignon a bu la pluie… {mushroom:glow} {mushroom:live grow} et il a grandi, juste un petit peu. « Il y a de la place pour tous ! » a dit Champignon. {frog:face happy} {ladybug:face happy} [laughs] Alors ils ont ri, tout serrés, jusqu’à ce que {canvas:rain stop} la pluie s’arrête. {canvas:sunshine} Le soleil est sorti. {snail:live hide resume} Escargot a sorti ses cornes. {ladybug:go back} Coccinelle est sortie. {frog:go back} Grenouille a bondi dehors. [happily] Et Champignon se tenait là, au soleil, juste un petit peu plus grand.

it-IT.title: Fungo cresce sotto la pioggia
it-IT.text: {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} [softly] Plic, ploc, plic, ploc. Sul prato cadeva la pioggia. {ladybug:enter} Coccinella è corsa verso il {mushroom:enter} fungo rosso {ladybug:go under mushroom} e si è riparata sotto il suo cappello. {mushroom:face happy} [warmly] «Entra, entra!» ha detto Fungo. Piano piano, è arrivata {snail:enter} Chiocciola. «C'è posto anche per me?» {mushroom:live nod} «Ma certo!» {snail:go under mushroom} E si è stretta lì sotto. Nello stagno, {frog:enter} {frog:go to pond} Rana sguazzava. {frog:live jump} {sfx:splash} Splish, splash, SPLASH! [excited] «Io ADORO la pioggia!» Ma sotto il cappello, Coccinella e Chiocciola ridacchiavano insieme. {frog:face sad} Rana si è fermata. [sad] Sguazzare da sola non era poi così divertente. {frog:go under mushroom} Così si è infilata sotto anche lei. {ladybug:face surprised} Che pigia pigia! {snail:live hide hold} Chiocciola si è ritirata nel guscio per fare spazio. «Siamo troppi!» ha detto Coccinella. Ma Fungo si è bevuto la pioggia… {mushroom:glow} {mushroom:live grow} ed è cresciuto, solo un pochino. «C'è posto per tutti!» ha detto Fungo. {frog:face happy} {ladybug:face happy} [laughs] E sono rimasti lì, stretti stretti a ridere, finché {canvas:rain stop} ha smesso di piovere. {canvas:sunshine} Fuori il sole! {snail:live hide resume} Fuori Chiocciola. {ladybug:go back} Fuori Coccinella. {frog:go back} Fuori Rana, con un balzo. [happily] E lì, al sole, c'era Fungo, un pochino più alto di prima.

zh-TW.title: 蘑菇在雨中長大
zh-TW.text: {canvas:rain 0.7}{sfx:rain}[softly]滴滴答答，滴滴答答。草地上下起雨來了。{ladybug:enter}瓢蟲趕快跑向紅紅的{mushroom:enter}蘑菇，{ladybug:go under mushroom}躲進她的菇傘底下。{mushroom:face happy}[warmly]「快進來！」 蘑菇說。慢慢地，慢慢地，{snail:enter}蝸牛爬過來了。「我也可以進來嗎？」 {mushroom:live nod}「當然可以！」 {snail:go under mushroom}蝸牛擠了進去。{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙呢，正在池塘裡玩水。{frog:live jump}{sfx:splash}啪啦，啪啦，噗通！[excited]「我最喜歡下雨了！」 可是菇傘底下，瓢蟲和蝸牛正一起咯咯笑。{frog:face sad}青蛙停了下來。[sad]自己一個玩水，一點也不好玩。{frog:go under mushroom}於是，牠也擠了進去。{ladybug:face surprised}哎喲，好擠！{snail:live hide hold}蝸牛把身體縮進殼裡，讓出一點位子。「太多了啦！」 瓢蟲說。可是蘑菇把雨喝得飽飽的……{mushroom:glow}{mushroom:live grow}長大了，只大了一點點。「大家都擠得下了！」 蘑菇說。{frog:face happy}{ladybug:face happy}[laughs]大家擠成一團，咯咯笑個不停，一直到{canvas:rain stop}雨停了。{canvas:sunshine}太陽出來了。{snail:live hide resume}蝸牛探出頭來。{ladybug:go back}瓢蟲爬了出來。{frog:go back}青蛙跳了出來。[happily]蘑菇站在陽光下，比原來高了一點點。

zh-HK.title: 落雨天的蘑菇
zh-HK.text: {canvas:rain 0.7}{sfx:rain}[softly]滴答、滴答，滴滴答答。草地上下起雨來了。{ladybug:enter}瓢蟲連忙跑到紅色的{mushroom:enter}蘑菇那裏，{ladybug:go under mushroom}鑽到她的蘑菇帽下面。{mushroom:face happy}[warmly]「入嚟，入嚟！」 蘑菇說。慢慢地，慢慢地，{snail:enter}蝸牛爬過來了。「仲有冇位畀我呀？」 {mushroom:live nod}「梗係有啦！」 {snail:go under mushroom}蝸牛也擠了進去。池塘裏，{frog:enter}{frog:go to pond}青蛙正在玩水。{frog:live jump}{sfx:splash}撲通！嘩啦！嘩啦！[excited]「我最鍾意落雨㗎！」 可是在蘑菇帽下面，瓢蟲和蝸牛正一起咯咯地笑。{frog:face sad}青蛙停了下來。[sad]自己一個玩水，原來一點也不好玩。{frog:go under mushroom}於是，牠也擠了進去。{ladybug:face surprised}哎喲，好擠呀！{snail:live hide hold}蝸牛把身子縮進殼裏，讓出一點位置。「迫唔落喇！」 瓢蟲說。可是蘑菇吸飽了雨水……{mushroom:glow}{mushroom:live grow}長大了，大了一點點。「大家都有位喇！」 蘑菇說。{frog:face happy}{ladybug:face happy}[laughs]大家擠在一起，笑個不停，一直到{canvas:rain stop}雨停了。{canvas:sunshine}太陽出來了。{snail:live hide resume}蝸牛探出頭來。{ladybug:go back}瓢蟲爬出來。{frog:go back}青蛙跳出來。[happily]蘑菇站在陽光下，比之前高了一點點。

rain.prompt: gentle rain pattering on grass and big leaves, realistic field recording

splash.prompt: a small frog splashing in a shallow pond, three light quick splashes, realistic
